title: DARPA special access program to reverse-engineer cephalopod camouflage

tellings.quote: mindblowing oh well my my special Access program um was trying to reverse engineer uh camouflage from spilop pods

plain: John Blitch, who worked as a scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, says that around 2000 he ran a special access program, a tightly restricted secret project, that tried to reverse engineer, or work out how to copy, the camouflage of cephalopods such as octopuses and squid. He tells Michels this from his own work and calls it "mindblowing", naming the researchers Roger Hanlon, Benny Hochner and Tamar Flash in connection with it.
